verdict: Organic presence holding; paid channels inactive and overdue work is being resolved.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, every lead-generating action came exclusively from organic local presence — no paid campaigns ran on Meta or Google Ads for the full 28 days. Combined, your profiles delivered 339 Google Business Profile actions (11 calls, 211 direction requests, 115 web clicks), with O'Hare Precision driving the strongest search footprint at 399 clicks and 64,243 impressions. GBP engagement softened sharply in the final week across all three profiles, a directional decline being watched closely as the Web/SEO root cause fix and site reindexing work moves forward. Several CRM and outreach milestones that were due in July and August are being cleared now so that downstream email, calling, and paid channel work can launch on schedule.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement fell sharply across all three profiles in the last 7 days, coinciding with declining search visibility; two of O'Hare's three listings received zero calls despite 350 combined impressions this period.
watch_item.fix: The Web/SEO root-cause fix and site reindexing are in progress with a target of all three sites recovering by end of October; listing conversion issues are being reviewed alongside that work.
